description: React component for editing OAuth applications within Mattermost, including modal confirmation and form submission logic.

classes.name: EditOAuthApp
classes.description: React component class for editing OAuth applications, managing state, and rendering the UI.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches OAuth app details if OAuth service provider is enabled upon component mount.

methods.name: editOAuthApp
methods.description: Handles editing of OAuth app, checks for callback URL changes, and prompts confirmation if needed.

methods.name: handleConfirmModal
methods.description: Displays the confirmation modal before updating OAuth app.

methods.name: submitOAuthApp
methods.description: Submits the OAuth app data to update, handles success and error responses.

methods.name: renderExtra
methods.description: Renders the confirmation modal with localized messages.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main component UI, including loading state and OAuth app form.
